subject: Secure SDLC evidence: CI/CD access, PR gating, and secret rotation
messages:
From: Security Assessor <security-assessor@finco.com>
To: monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: SDLC controls for SOC2 review

Hi Monica,

Thanks for agreeing to help with our SOC2 evidence collection. To complete the SDLC section of our assessment we need the following artifacts and short explanations: code review policy and sample PR approvals for the last 90 days, CI/CD pipeline access controls and RBAC, audit logs showing PR approvals/merges, secrets rotation report (KMS/HSM or vault), and change request/approval records for any production changes in Q1 2025.

Can you provide a single bundle (zipped) with the artifacts and short README describing where each item came from and who owns it? Ideally we get this by EOD Monday, 21 Apr. If anything above is sensitive and needs a different delivery channel, please flag.

Best,
Chris Mallory
Security Assessment Team
FinCo Bank

--
Attachment: evidence_request_template.docx (docx)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Apr 2025 10:05:12 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Evidence request: SDLC controls for SOC2 review

Folks — forwarding FinCo's ask (below). They want a zipped bundle + README by EOD Monday. Quick priorities:

1) PR approvals & code review evidence (last 90 days) — Aditya, can you pull PR approval logs + a short explanation of our review policy? Include the GHA runs that enforce required reviewers.
2) CI/CD RBAC and runbook — Laura, please export the pipeline ACLs, service account list, and the runbook for release gating.
3) Secrets rotation & KMS evidence — Rishi, share rotation logs and the KMS rotation summary.
4) Change approvals for prod in Q1 — I'll collate change tickets and approver signatures (Jira links).

If anything is missing or you need me to escalate, I can loop security or infra. I'll assemble the zip and add the README once you drop artifacts in the shared Drive folder.

Thanks — Monica
Head of Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 19 Apr 2025 08:22:43 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evidence request: SDLC controls for SOC2 review

Monica — dropping what I have so far. I pulled artifacts from GitHub/GHA and our internal audit store. Summary below; artifacts uploaded to Drive (see link Monica mentioned). Attachments included for quick reference.

- Code review policy (POLICY_code_review_v3.md) — describes required reviewers, approval counts, and exceptions for hotfixes.
- PR approvals log (pr-approval-audit.csv) — includes PR id, author, approvers, timestamps, labels (SECURE-GATE/WIP), and merge commit. Sample shows enforced 2-reviewer rule for prod merges.
- Example PR chain (PR#8243) — demonstrates reviewer rotation and auto-merge blocked until CI+security-scan pass.
- GHA enforcement snippet (actions/required-reviewers.yml) — shows required checks and the prevent-merge bot.

Attachments: pr-approval-audit.csv (csv), example-pr-8243.patch (diff)

Open items: I couldn't export the full 90-day webhook logs due to retention limits; I included a summarized CSV and CI run IDs. If FinCo needs raw webhook payloads, infra can pull from the archive for a narrower timeframe.

Cheers,
Aditya
Senior Software Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: monica.patel@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 20 Apr 2025 09:41:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evidence request: SDLC controls for SOC2 review

Adding CI/CD and release gating artifacts. Notes:

- CI/CD runbook (ci-pipeline-runbook.pdf) — describes environment tiers, who can trigger prod runs, required approvals, and canary release steps.
- Pipeline ACL export (pipeline-acl-20250420.json) — service accounts, roles, and who can deploy to prod. (sensitive; included in zip under secure/ with access controls).
- Release approval traces — I exported the release-approval logs for Q1 (release-approvals-Q1.csv) showing approver identity and timestamp.

Important: We use ephemeral deploy keys for the autopusher and a separate service account for migrations. Both are rotated via our KMS integration. I flagged the entries in the runbook where we require explicit manager signoff for DB migrations.

Attachments: ci-pipeline-runbook.pdf, release-approvals-Q1.csv

Laura Bennett
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: monica.patel@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2025 11:04:55 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evidence request: SDLC controls for SOC2 review

Monica — attached the secrets/KMS rotation summary and a short note on our rotation cadence. Key points:

- KMS rotation summary (kms-rotation-summary.txt) — lists key IDs, last rotated timestamp, and rotation owner. Keys for production were rotated on 2025-03-15 as part of quarterly rotation.
- Vault secrets rotation report (vault-rotation-20250420.csv) — shows rotation events for service accounts and ephemeral tokens.
- Access control evidence — exported IAM role assumptions for the deploy service account and a recent key-access audit (key-access-audit.log).

I also included a short signed statement (signed-by-rishi.txt) confirming retention policies and the process we follow for emergency key rotations.

If FinCo requires HSM attestation docs, I'll coordinate with infra and prepare the request to our cloud provider; that will take 2 business days.

Rishi
Engineering Security Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Chris Mallory <security-assessor@finco.com>, compliance@finco.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2025 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SDLC controls for SOC2 review

Hi Chris / FinCo team — thanks for the request and your patience. Per our internal timeline we compiled the artifacts and uploaded a signed bundle to the secure Drive link below. The bundle contains: PR approval CSV, sample PR diffs, CI runbook, pipeline ACL export, release approval traces (Q1), KMS rotation summary, vault rotation report, and a README mapping each file to the FinCo request items.

Delivery
- Secure bundle: https://drive.redwood.com/finco/SR-2025/sdlc-evidence (access granted to security-assessor@finco.com)
- ZIP attachment: redwood_sdlc_artifacts_20250420.zip (contains redacted copies for external delivery)

Notes and exceptions- We redacted internal developer emails in some exports for privacy; full raw webhook payloads are available on request (we can pull a narrowed timeframe).
- HSM attestation is not directly held by Redwood; we can request an HSM attestation (2 business days).

Next steps
- Confirm receipt and whether you want PR webhook payloads or the summarized CSV.
- If FinCo needs an on-call walk-through of the runbook, we can schedule a 60-minute session with Platform and Engineering Security.

Best,
Monica Patel
Head of Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
